sources.locator: "Siege of Ciudad Rodrigo (1812)", revision 1370740278, lead and § Aftermath

explanation: The article states it in the word the vocabulary has for it: the fall of the city "opened the northern gateway into French-occupied Spain from Portugal", and "It also allowed Wellington to proceed to Badajoz on the southern corridor, whose taking would be a much more bloody affair." Its aftermath reads "The allied campaign in Spain proceeded with the siege of Badajoz." Probable: Wikipedia alone.
